entries.label: Path traversal to /etc/passwd
entries.notes: World-readable canonical target; confirms arbitrary file read on Unix.

entries.label: Over-deep traversal
entries.notes: Extra ../ past filesystem root are harmless and cover an unknown include base depth.

entries.label: Absolute path
entries.notes: Direct absolute path; works when the app does not prepend a base directory.

entries.label: Process environment
entries.notes: Often leaks secrets in env vars and is a classic LFI-to-RCE pivot via env/log poisoning.

entries.label: Process command line
entries.notes: Reveals the target process invocation and its arguments.

entries.label: php://filter base64 source read
entries.notes: Reads PHP source without executing it by base64-encoding through the filter wrapper.

entries.label: php://filter rot13 source read
entries.notes: Alternative filter when base64 is blocked; rot13 still stops the engine from executing the file.

entries.label: data:// inline payload
entries.notes: data:// inlines code (here phpinfo) when allow_url_include is enabled.

entries.label: php://input body include
entries.notes: Pairs with a POST body to deliver code when the include target is php://input.

entries.label: Remote file inclusion
entries.notes: Pulls attacker-hosted code when allow_url_include permits remote URLs.

entries.label: Null-byte extension truncation
entries.notes: Legacy %00 drops an appended extension the app adds (PHP < 5.3.4).

entries.label: Doubled dot-slash
entries.notes: ....// survives a single non-recursive strip of ../, reconstituting the traversal.

entries.label: URL-encoded traversal
entries.notes: Percent-encoded slashes bypass filters that only match literal ../.

entries.label: Double-encoded traversal
entries.notes: Double URL-encoding for stacks that decode twice before the file read.

entries.label: Overlong UTF-8 slash
entries.notes: Overlong UTF-8 encoding of / bypasses some path canonicalizers.

entries.label: Windows traversal to win.ini
entries.notes: win.ini is a reliable readable proof file on Windows targets.

entries.label: Windows hosts file
entries.notes: Readable on default Windows installs; confirms traversal on Windows.

entries.label: Apache access log include
entries.notes: Include a request-controlled log to escalate LFI to RCE after seeding PHP in a header.

entries.label: SSH private key read
entries.notes: A readable private key escalates LFI to host access; sensitive, read-only.

entries.label: expect:// command execution
entries.notes: expect:// runs a command directly when the PECL expect extension is loaded.
